roe.name: Return on equity
roe.equation: core PAT / average equity (share capital + reserves)
roe.meaning: Owners' core profit per rupee of shareholders' equity.

band.rationale: ROE below the cost of equity destroys value; 5pp above it is clear value creation. Ke = rf + beta x ERP (config/market.yaml).

roce.name: Return on capital employed
roce.equation: EBIT / average (equity + borrowings), EBIT = core PBT + interest
roce.meaning: Pre-tax operating return on all funding (Screener's definition).

band.rationale: ROCE is pre-tax, so the hurdle is the pre-tax WACC.

roce.text: Return on capital employed: 39.2% GREEN (level green vs band (red <= 16.6%, green >= 23.3%); trend stable +0.1pp/yr; stable (CV 0.12))

roic.name: Return on invested capital
roic.equation: NOPAT / average IC; NOPAT = (EBITDA - Dep) x (1 - ETR), ETR = core tax / core PBT clipped 0-40% (statutory if PBT <= 0); IC = equity + borrowings - cash - investments (+ manual minority interest); n/m if IC <= 0
roic.meaning: After-tax operating return on the capital actually tied up in operations (excludes cash, investments and the income they earn).

band.rationale: ROIC below WACC destroys value; 5pp above it is clear value creation.

roic.text: Return on invested capital: 48.3% GREEN (level green vs band (red <= 12.4%, green >= 17.4%); trend stable -0.3pp/yr; stable (CV 0.08))

roic_wacc_spread.name: ROIC - WACC
roic_wacc_spread.equation: ROIC - WACC (WACC from config/market.yaml, see capital_cost.py)
roic_wacc_spread.meaning: Value created per rupee of invested capital: positive = earns more than investors require.

band.rationale: Spread below zero = value destruction; above +5pp = clear value creation.

roic_wacc_spread.text: ROIC - WACC: +35.9pp GREEN (level green vs band (red <= +0.0pp, green >= +5.0pp); trend stable -0.3pp/yr; stable (CV 0.12))

incremental_roic_3y.name: Incremental ROIC 3y
incremental_roic_3y.equation: (NOPAT_t - NOPAT_t-3) / (avg IC_t - avg IC_t-3); n/m if capital grew < 5%
incremental_roic_3y.meaning: Return on the capital added over the last 3 years: is new money earning as much as the old?

band.rationale: New capital should earn at least its cost.

incremental_roic_3y.text: Incremental ROIC 3y: 54.8% GREEN (level green vs band (red <= 12.4%, green >= 17.4%); trend deteriorating -10.2pp/yr; volatile (CV 0.40))

attributable_factor.name: Attributable-profit factor
attributable_factor.meaning: Owners' share of after-tax profit: below 1 = minorities take a slice; above 1 = associate/JV income adds to it.

tax_burden.name: Tax burden
tax_burden.meaning: Share of pre-tax profit kept after tax (1 - effective tax rate).

interest_burden.name: Interest burden
interest_burden.meaning: Share of EBIT left after interest.

equity_multiplier.name: Equity multiplier
equity_multiplier.meaning: Assets per rupee of equity: the leverage term in DuPont.

debt_to_equity_avg.name: Borrowings / equity (average)
debt_to_equity_avg.meaning: Debt part of the equity multiplier.

other_liab_to_equity_avg.name: Other liabilities / equity (average)
other_liab_to_equity_avg.meaning: Non-debt liabilities part of the equity multiplier.

nopat_margin.name: NOPAT margin
nopat_margin.meaning: After-tax operating profit per rupee of revenue (the margin half of ROIC).

reinvestment_rate.name: Reinvestment rate
reinvestment_rate.equation: (Capex proxy - Depreciation + change in NWC) / NOPAT (NOPAT > 0); NWC = other assets - cash - other liabilities
reinvestment_rate.meaning: Share of after-tax operating profit ploughed back into fixed assets and working capital. Good only if incremental ROIC exceeds WACC.

payout_ratio.name: Dividend payout
payout_ratio.meaning: Share of core profit paid as dividends (Screener 'Dividend Amount', declared for the year).

share_count_change.name: Share count change
share_count_change.meaning: Net issuance (dilution, +) or buyback (-) of shares, adjusted for splits and bonuses.

band.rationale: Net issuance above 3% a year is material dilution; flat or falling share count = no dilution/buybacks.

share_count_change.text: Share count change: -2.4% GREEN (level green vs band (green <= 0.0%, red >= 3.0%); trend stable -0.1pp/yr; moderate (CV 0.34))

buyback_estimate.name: Buyback (estimate)
buyback_estimate.equation: max(0, -(Adj shares_t - Adj shares_t-1)) x (Price_t + Price_t-1)/2
buyback_estimate.meaning: Estimated rupees spent on buybacks: shares retired x average of the two year-end prices.

shareholder_yield.name: Shareholder yield
shareholder_yield.meaning: Cash returned to shareholders (dividends + estimated buybacks) as a share of year-end market value.

dividend_to_fcf.name: Dividends / FCF
dividend_to_fcf.equation: Dividend / (CFO - capex proxy); 99 if FCF <= 0 and dividend > 0; 0 if no dividend
dividend_to_fcf.meaning: Dividends relative to free cash flow: above 1 = payouts funded from the balance sheet (99 = dividend paid with FCF <= 0).

band.rationale: Paying out more than 120% of FCF must be funded by cash reserves or debt; under 70% leaves room to reinvest.

dividend_to_fcf.text: Dividends / FCF: 0.73 GREEN (level amber vs band (green <= 0.70, red >= 1.20))

net_debt_to_ebitda.name: Net debt / EBITDA
net_debt_to_ebitda.meaning: Years of operating profit needed to repay net debt (negative = net cash). Borrowings include lease liabilities.

band.rationale: S&P Corporate Methodology financial-risk benchmarks (standard volatility): debt/EBITDA < 1.5x minimal, 1.5-2x modest, 2-3x intermediate, 3-4x significant, 4-5x aggressive, > 5x highly leveraged (summary: https://ibinterviewquestions.com/guides/debt-capital-markets/rating-methodology-how-agencies-score-credit). Engine uses net debt, so the band is slightly lenient.

net_debt_to_equity.name: Net debt / equity
net_debt_to_equity.meaning: Net financial leverage on book equity.

band.rationale: Net debt above 1.5x book equity is aggressive for an Indian non-financial; under 0.5x is conservative.

interest_cover.name: Interest cover
interest_cover.equation: EBIT / Interest, EBIT = core PBT + interest; = 99 if interest ~ 0; clipped to [-99, 99]
interest_cover.meaning: How many times EBIT covers interest (capped at 99x when interest is negligible).

band.rationale: Damodaran synthetic rating (large non-financial firms, Jan 2026): coverage < 2.5x maps below BBB (sub-investment grade); >= 4.25x maps to A or better.

interest_cover.text: Interest cover: 97.14x GREEN (level green vs band (red <= 2.50x, green >= 4.25x); trend stable -1.13x/yr; stable (CV 0.07))

current_ratio_proxy.name: Current ratio (Screener proxy)
current_ratio_proxy.meaning: Short-term liquidity proxy: the export has no current/non-current split, so other assets / other liabilities is used (Screener's own working-capital split). Excludes short-term debt (inside Borrowings).

band.rationale: Textbook liquidity norm: below 1.0x short-term obligations exceed short-term assets; 1.5x+ is comfortable. Proxy excludes short-term debt.

current_ratio_proxy.text: Current ratio (Screener proxy): 1.88x GREEN (level green vs band (red <= 1.00x, green >= 1.50x); trend stable 0.01x/yr; moderate (CV 0.27))

cash_to_st_borrowings.name: Cash / short-term borrowings
cash_to_st_borrowings.equation: Cash & bank / short-term borrowings (manual) or / Borrowings; = 99 when there is no debt
cash_to_st_borrowings.meaning: Cash cover for debt falling due soon. Uses manual short_term_borrowings when supplied, otherwise total borrowings (conservative: treats all debt as short-term).

band.rationale: Cash covering all short-term debt (1.0x) removes refinancing risk; under 0.2x depends on rollovers.

cash_to_st_borrowings.text: Cash / short-term borrowings: 2.42x GREEN (level green vs band (red <= 0.20x, green >= 1.00x); trend stable -0.00x/yr; volatile (CV 1.46))

debt_vs_ebitda_growth.name: Debt growth - EBITDA growth
debt_vs_ebitda_growth.equation: (Borrowings_t/Borrowings_t-1 - 1) - (EBITDA_t/EBITDA_t-1 - 1); n/m if prior debt < 1% of assets or prior EBITDA <= 0
debt_vs_ebitda_growth.meaning: Debt growing faster than the profit that services it (n/m when debt was negligible).

band.rationale: Debt growing 10pp a year faster than EBITDA erodes coverage quickly.

debt_vs_ebitda_growth.text: Debt growth - EBITDA growth: +3.8pp AMBER (level amber vs band (green <= +0.0pp, red >= +10.0pp); trend improving -2.2pp/yr; volatile (CV 9.75))

altman_x2.name: Altman Z'' X2
altman_x2.meaning: Reserves (proxy for retained earnings; includes securities premium) / total assets

altman_x4.name: Altman Z'' X4
altman_x4.meaning: Book equity / total liabilities (book value replaces market value in Z'')

altman_z_india.name: Altman Z''-EM (India-adapted)
altman_z_india.meaning: Distress score for emerging-market non-financials (Altman 2005 EM score: Z'' + 3.25) using Screener proxies. Above 5.85 safe, below 4.35 distress zone.

band.rationale: Altman (2005), Emerging Markets Review 6(4): EM score = Z'' + 3.25; Z'' zones safe > 2.6, distress < 1.1 => EM score safe > 5.85, distress < 4.35. Engine uses Screener proxies (see docs/methodology.md).

altman_z_india.text: Altman Z''-EM (India-adapted): 10.47 GREEN (level green vs band (red <= 4.35, green >= 5.85); trend stable -0.01/yr; moderate (CV 0.16))

cfo_to_ebitda.name: CFO / EBITDA
cfo_to_ebitda.meaning: How much of operating profit arrives as operating cash (after working capital and tax).

band.rationale: After tax (~25%) and normal working-capital needs, 80%+ of EBITDA should arrive as CFO; below 50% means profit is being absorbed by working capital.

cfo_to_ebitda.text: CFO / EBITDA: 0.80 GREEN (level green vs band (red <= 0.50, green >= 0.80); trend improving 0.04/yr; stable (CV 0.12))

fcf_to_pat.name: FCF / PAT
fcf_to_pat.meaning: Free cash flow per rupee of core profit in the year.

band.rationale: Single-year FCF is lumpy (capex cycles), hence the wide amber zone; use the 5-year version for judgement.

fcf_to_pat.text: FCF / PAT: 0.90 GREEN (level green vs band (red <= 0.20, green >= 0.80); trend improving 0.03/yr; moderate (CV 0.25))

fcf_to_pat_5y.name: FCF / PAT (5y cumulative)
fcf_to_pat_5y.meaning: Free cash flow conversion over a full cycle (5 years), smoothing lumpy capex.

band.rationale: Over a cycle, a mature business should convert 70%+ of profit into free cash; below 30% profit is being reinvested or is not real.

fcf_to_pat_5y.text: FCF / PAT (5y cumulative): 0.87 GREEN (level green vs band (red <= 0.30, green >= 0.70); trend improving 0.03/yr; stable (CV 0.08))

cfo_to_pat_5y.name: CFO / PAT (5y cumulative)
cfo_to_pat_5y.meaning: Operating cash flow conversion of profits over 5 years: below 60% means profits are not turning into cash.

band.rationale: Cumulative CFO below 60% of cumulative PAT over 5 years is the red-flag threshold in the brief; 90%+ = profits are cash-backed.

accruals_ratio.name: Accruals ratio
accruals_ratio.meaning: Profit not backed by operating cash, scaled by assets (Sloan-style total accruals): high = lower-quality earnings.

band.rationale: Sloan (1996), The Accounting Review 71(3): firms in the extreme accrual decile (accruals around 10%+ of assets) have lower subsequent earnings persistence and returns. Negative accruals (cash > profit) = green.

accruals_ratio.text: Accruals ratio: -3.0% GREEN (level green vs band (green <= 0.0%, red >= 10.0%); trend improving -1.1pp/yr; volatile (CV 0.60))

receivables_vs_revenue_growth.name: Receivables growth - revenue growth
receivables_vs_revenue_growth.equation: (Rec_t / Rec_t-1 - 1) - (Rev_t / Rev_t-1 - 1); n/m if prior receivables < 0.5% of revenue
receivables_vs_revenue_growth.meaning: Receivables growing faster than sales can signal channel stuffing, looser credit or collection problems.

band.rationale: Receivables outgrowing revenue by 10pp+ in a year is a classic quality warning (Beneish DSRI logic).

receivables_vs_revenue_growth.text: Receivables growth - revenue growth: +3.5pp RED (level amber vs band (green <= +0.0pp, red >= +10.0pp); trend deteriorating +2.0pp/yr; volatile (CV 4.28))

exceptional_frequency_5y.name: Exceptional items frequency (5y)
exceptional_frequency_5y.equation: count over last 5 years of [|estimated exceptional| > 5% x |PBT|]
exceptional_frequency_5y.meaning: In how many of the last 5 years profit contained a material exceptional item (|item| > 5% of PBT).

band.rationale: One exceptional year in five is normal; three or more means 'exceptional' items are recurring.

exceptional_frequency_5y.text: Exceptional items frequency (5y): 0 GREEN (level green vs band (green <= 1, red >= 3); trend improving -0/yr)

exceptional_size_5y.name: Exceptional items size (5y)
exceptional_size_5y.meaning: How big exceptional items were relative to profit over 5 years.

band.rationale: Exceptional items above 20% of cumulative PBT make reported profit an unreliable guide to core earnings.

exceptional_size_5y.text: Exceptional items size (5y): 0.0% GREEN (level green vs band (green <= 5.0%, red >= 20.0%); trend improving -0.3pp/yr)

beneish_dsri.name: Beneish DSRI
beneish_dsri.meaning: Days-sales-in-receivables index: receivables/sales this year vs last.

beneish_gmi.name: Beneish GMI
beneish_gmi.meaning: Gross-margin index: last year's gross margin / this year's (>1 = deteriorating margins).

beneish_aqi.name: Beneish AQI
beneish_aqi.equation: [1 - (CA_t + NB_t)/TA_t] / [1 - (CA_t-1 + NB_t-1)/TA_t-1], CA proxy = receivables + inventory + cash
beneish_aqi.meaning: Asset-quality index: share of 'soft' assets (not current assets or net block) this year vs last.

beneish_depi.name: Beneish DEPI
beneish_depi.equation: DepRate_t-1 / DepRate_t, DepRate = Dep / (Dep + Net block)
beneish_depi.meaning: Depreciation index: last year's depreciation rate / this year's (>1 = slower depreciation).

beneish_sgai.name: Beneish SGAI
beneish_sgai.equation: (SGA_t/Sales_t) / (SGA_t-1/Sales_t-1), SGA proxy = selling & admin + other expenses (other opex if that is <= 0)
beneish_sgai.meaning: SG&A index: SG&A/sales this year vs last.

beneish_lvgi.name: Beneish LVGI
beneish_lvgi.meaning: Leverage index: (debt + other liabilities)/assets this year vs last.

beneish_m_score.name: Beneish M-score (Screener proxies)
beneish_m_score.meaning: Probability-style earnings-manipulation screen (Beneish 1999, 8 variables) built from Screener line items. Above -1.78 = profile resembles known manipulators; a screen, not proof.

band.rationale: Beneish (1999), Financial Analysts Journal 55(5): 8-variable M-score; above -1.78 classifies as a likely manipulator. -2.22 is the stricter cut-off used in later work (Beneish, Lee & Nichols 2013, FAJ 69(2), https://doi.org/10.2469/faj.v69.n2.1).

dol.meaning: How much EBIT moves for a 1% move in sales: high DOL magnifies both upturns and downturns.

ebitda_margin_sd_10y.name: EBITDA margin volatility (sd)
ebitda_margin_sd_10y.equation: sd(EBITDA margin_t) over the last 10 years (>= 4 needed, sample sd)
ebitda_margin_sd_10y.meaning: Standard deviation of the EBITDA margin over up to 10 years: pricing power and cost pass-through.

band.rationale: EBITDA margin moving within +/-2pp over a decade signals pricing power; a 5pp+ standard deviation signals commodity exposure or weak pass-through.

ebitda_margin_sd_10y.text: EBITDA margin volatility (sd): +1.6pp GREEN (level green vs band (green <= +2.0pp, red >= +5.0pp))

other_income_to_pbt.name: Other income / PBT
other_income_to_pbt.equation: Other income (reported, incl. exceptional) / PBT (reported); n/m if PBT <= 0
other_income_to_pbt.meaning: How much of pre-tax profit comes from other income (treasury, one-offs) rather than operations (reported basis).

band.rationale: Above 25% of PBT from other income = profits depend on treasury/one-offs (the red-flag threshold in the brief); under 10% = operations drive profit.

other_income_to_pbt.text: Other income / PBT: 7.6% GREEN (level green vs band (green <= 10.0%, red >= 25.0%); trend stable +0.1pp/yr; moderate (CV 0.30))

q_ebitda_margin_yoy_change.name: Latest quarter EBITDA margin change YoY
q_ebitda_margin_yoy_change.equation: OPM_q - OPM_q-4, OPM = operating profit / revenue
q_ebitda_margin_yoy_change.meaning: Latest quarter's operating margin versus the same quarter a year earlier.

band.rationale: A 1pp year-on-year move in quarterly operating margin is material for most companies.

q_ebitda_margin_yoy_change.text: Latest quarter EBITDA margin change YoY: +0.1pp AMBER (level amber vs band (red <= -1.0pp, green >= +1.0pp))

dep_to_sales.name: Depreciation / sales
dep_to_sales.meaning: Depreciation per rupee of revenue (bridge from EBITDA to EBIT margin).

oi_core_to_sales.name: Core other income / sales
oi_core_to_sales.meaning: Recurring other income per rupee of revenue (bridge from EBITDA to EBIT margin).

operating_margin.name: Operating (EBIT excl. other income) margin
operating_margin.meaning: Operating EBIT per rupee of revenue, excluding other income (used for NOPAT/ROIC).

economic_profit.name: Economic profit
economic_profit.equation: Non-financials: (ROIC - WACC) x average IC = NOPAT - WACC x average IC (defined even when IC <= 0); financials: (ROE - Ke) x average equity
economic_profit.meaning: Rupees of value created (or destroyed) in the year after charging for all capital at its required return.

pe.name: P/E
pe.equation: Market cap / core PAT (current: TTM PAT when available)
pe.meaning: P/E multiple. Series = FY-end values; the last value is the current multiple (export price) in a latest run.
pe.note: current = market cap / TTM from last 4 quarters PAT (reported quarterly PAT)

pe_percentile_10y.name: P/E percentile vs own history
pe_percentile_10y.equation: (# historical FY-end P/E below current + 0.5 x # equal) / # historical values
pe_percentile_10y.meaning: Where today's P/E sits within the company's own FY-end history (0% = cheapest ever, 100% = richest). Needs >= 5 years.

band.rationale: Bottom third of the company's own 10-year range = cheap versus itself; top third = rich versus itself.

implied_growth_reverse_dcf.name: Reverse-DCF implied FCF growth (10y)
implied_growth_reverse_dcf.equation: solve g: EV = sum_{t=1..10} F0(1+g)^t/(1+WACC)^t + F10(1+gT)/((WACC-gT)(1+WACC)^10), F0 = NOPAT0 x (1 - gT/RONIC), RONIC = 3y avg ROIC (capped at 100%)
implied_growth_reverse_dcf.meaning: Annual free-cash-flow growth for the next 10 years that today's enterprise value implies, starting from the steady-state FCF the business generates at its 3-year average ROIC, then growing at the terminal rate.
implied_growth_reverse_dcf.note: solved; EV 446,003 cr, NOPAT 27,545 cr, base FCF 23,847 cr, WACC 12.45%, RONIC 44.7%, terminal g 6.0%, 10y
implied_growth_reverse_dcf.text: Reverse-DCF implied FCF growth (10y): 7.8% [informational (neutral direction)] Note: solved; EV 446,003 cr, NOPAT 27,545 cr, base FCF 23,847 cr, WACC 12.45%, RONIC 44.7%, terminal g 6.0%, 10y

implied_minus_delivered_growth.name: Implied - delivered growth
implied_minus_delivered_growth.equation: implied_growth_reverse_dcf - 5y NOPAT CAGR (revenue CAGR 5y if NOPAT CAGR is n/m)
implied_minus_delivered_growth.meaning: How much faster the market expects NOPAT to grow than it did over the last 5 years (positive = priced for acceleration).

band.rationale: Price requiring 5pp+ faster growth than delivered over the last 5 years = expectations risk; at or below delivered = undemanding.

implied_minus_delivered_growth.text: Implied - delivered growth: -1.2pp GREEN (level green vs band (green <= +0.0pp, red >= +5.0pp))

justified_pb.name: Justified P/B
justified_pb.equation: (ROE - g) / (Ke - g); ROE = 3y avg, g = min(ROE x (1 - 3y avg payout), terminal g)
justified_pb.meaning: P/B a single-stage residual-income model supports: (ROE - g) / (Ke - g) with sustainable ROE and growth.
justified_pb.text: Justified P/B: 3.77x [informational (neutral direction)] Note: ROE 30.8%, g 6.0%, Ke 12.57%

pb_to_justified_pb.name: P/B / justified P/B
pb_to_justified_pb.meaning: Market P/B relative to what returns justify: above 1 = paying for more than current ROE supports.

band.rationale: Paying 50%+ above the P/B that sustainable ROE justifies needs ROE to rise; at or below 1.0x the price is covered by current returns.

pb_to_justified_pb.text: P/B / justified P/B: 1.37x AMBER (level amber vs band (green <= 1.00x, red >= 1.50x))

ev_ic.name: EV / invested capital
ev_ic.meaning: Market value of operations per rupee of capital invested in them.

ev_ic_to_roic_wacc.name: (EV/IC) / (ROIC/WACC)
ev_ic_to_roic_wacc.equation: (EV / IC) / (ROIC / WACC), ROIC = latest, WACC = current
ev_ic_to_roic_wacc.meaning: In a no-growth steady state EV/IC = ROIC/WACC. Above 1 = the market pays for growth or improvement beyond today's returns; below 1 = priced for decline.

band.rationale: In steady state EV/IC = ROIC/WACC; 50%+ above that requires growth or rising returns to be justified.

data_notes.text: Source file INFY.xlsx; sha256 a3510de175415f26...; Screener template version 2.1. Only the 'Data Sheet' is read (display sheets are formulas without cached values).
Units: Rs crore. Share counts in crore (Screener 'Adjusted Equity Shares in Cr'); prices in Rs.
Data Sheet has 2 formula cell(s) without cached values (e.g. 'Number of shares'); recomputed where needed.
Blank line items are treated as zero (Screener leaves zero items blank; the P&L and balance-sheet identities hold on that basis). Blank price or share count = missing.

Estimated exceptional item 1,753 (pre-tax, gain): other income 4.7% of sales vs normal 2.2% (median of other years). Core profit excludes it (tax effect at statutory rate). Override via data/manual (exceptional_items).

Net profit differs from PBT - tax in 8 of 10 years (latest -34.00): minority interest (negative) and share of associates/JVs (positive) sit between PBT and net profit, so the export is consolidated and net profit is the owners' share. Equity excludes minority interest (Screener includes NCI in Other Liabilities); ROIC/ROCE capital therefore omits NCI unless data/manual supplies minority_interest.

Screener puts exceptional items inside Other Income (PBT = Sales - Expenses + Other income - Dep - Interest holds exactly). Other income is split into core and estimated exceptional (see 'exceptional').

Capex is not in the export. Proxy = change in net block + change in CWIP + depreciation (includes acquired fixed assets and Ind AS 116 right-of-use additions; impairments and disposals understate it). FCF = CFO - capex proxy.

Per-share history is split/bonus/rights-adjusted by Screener (adjusted shares / reported shares: FY17 x2.01, FY18 x2.01, FY19 x1.01). EPS, BVPS, DPS and FY-end prices all use the adjusted basis, so ratios are unaffected; per-share levels are in today's share units (a unit look-ahead, not an information look-ahead).
Current price and market cap are as of the export date, which the file does not record (latest quarter in file: 2026-09-30).

Ind AS 116 (leases) visible in FY20, the first period starting on/after 1-Apr-2019: depreciation/sales +0.8%, other opex/sales -1.4%, interest/sales +0.2% vs FY19. Lease rentals moved out of operating costs into depreciation and interest, so EBITDA margins before and after FY20 are not comparable; lease liabilities sit inside Borrowings.
10 quarters from 2024-06-30 to 2026-09-30 (Q1FY25-Q2FY27). Quarterly profit is as reported (no exceptional-item estimate).
